metadata.title: TAMAS — AI Business Assistant for MSMEs in Bali
metadata.description: Record sales and purchases in a sentence or a receipt photo, then see your business profit, what the owner took out, and the cash left. Free, in Bahasa Indonesia or English.

hero.title: Business is busy, so where did the money go?
hero.body: Record sales and purchases in a sentence or a receipt photo. TAMAS shows your business profit, the money that went to personal and adat needs, and the cash left. Something unclear? Ask the AI Advisor in everyday words.
hero.note: No bank login needed. Only you can see your transactions.

preview.answerTop: This month {taken} of business money went to personal and adat needs, out of {profit} profit.
preview.answerBottom: That is why only {cashLeft} of cash is left, even though the business made a profit. Try setting a limit on what the owner takes out, so cash doesn't run out before the next holy day.
preview.caption: Example answer from one month of a warung makan: {sales} sales, {costs} business costs.

howItWorks.title: From one sentence to your business profit, in three steps
howItWorks.body: No spreadsheets and no cashier app. You decide what goes in, and TAMAS helps you make sense of it.

quickEntry.title: Write it the way you'd say it
quickEntry.body: Type a sentence or take a photo of a receipt. TAMAS fills in the amount, category and date, and you check it before saving. The regular form is there too.

dashboard.title: See your profit and cash
dashboard.body: Your dashboard separates business profit from what the owner took out and from adat costs, so you can see why cash feels thin in a profitable month.

starterQuestions.title: Ask the Advisor about it
starterQuestions.body: Open the AI Advisor from any page and ask about your own numbers. Not sure what to ask? Start with one of the suggested questions.

profitExample.title: Business profit this month
profitExample.taken: Taken by the owner and adat

advisor.title: Questions that come up at closing time
advisor.body: The Advisor reads your business profile and the transactions you've recorded, then answers with your own figures and one practical next step. Here is what it says about one month of a warung makan.

profit.question: How much profit did I make this month?
profit.answer: Business profit is {profit}: {sales} in sales minus {costs} in business costs.

biggestCost.question: What is my biggest cost?
biggestCost.answer: Materials & stock, at {rawMaterials}. That's more than half of this month's business costs, so price differences there matter most.

cash.question: Why is cash short when I made a profit?
cash.answer: Of the {profit} profit, the owner took out {owner} and {ceremony} went to ceremonies and adat. That leaves {cashLeft} in cash.

fix.question: What should I fix this week?
fix.answer: Set a limit of {ownerCap} a month on what the owner takes out. Next month's cash grows by {trim} without changing sales.

sampleMonth.title: Sample month: warung makan
sampleMonth.taken: Taken by the owner and adat

privacy.title: You choose what the Advisor can see
privacy.body: One switch inside the Advisor, Personal or General, any time. In General mode, your transactions never reach the Advisor.

modes.personal: For questions about your business: profit, costs, cash left, and how it compares with last month.
modes.general: General guidance only: keeping business and personal money apart, setting a selling price, and preparing a KUR application.

noBankLogin.title: No bank login
noBankLogin.body: You add transactions yourself. TAMAS never asks for your bank or e-wallet password.

onlyYou.title: Only you can read your records
onlyYou.body: Every transaction is tied to your account, and the database refuses requests from anyone else.

realFigures.title: Figures from your records
realFigures.body: With data access on, the Advisor looks up your transactions before answering and says which period a number covers. It doesn't guess totals.

free.question: Is TAMAS free?
free.answer: Yes. Creating an account, recording transactions and asking the Advisor are free.

bank.question: Do I need to connect my bank account?
bank.answer: No. You add transactions yourself, by typing a sentence or filling in a short form. Nothing is pulled from your bank or e-wallet.

beginner.question: I don't know bookkeeping. Is this for me?
beginner.answer: It's built for exactly that. Record what comes in and goes out, and ask the Advisor anything in everyday words, like "why is cash short when I made a profit?". No accounting vocabulary needed.

languages.question: Which languages does TAMAS speak?
languages.answer: The app is in English or Bahasa Indonesia; switch any time from the menu at the top or in Profile. The Advisor replies in the language you write in, and uses Bahasa Indonesia if it can't tell.

visibility.question: Who can see my transactions?
visibility.answer: Only you. Each transaction belongs to your account, and the database rejects requests from anyone else. Switch the Advisor to General mode and it doesn't read them at all.

advice.question: Are the figures the same as an accounting report?
advice.answer: No. This is a simple profit figure for micro-businesses, and the Advisor only helps you understand your own records. For big decisions like a loan or taxes, talk to a professional too.

closing.title: Start with today's sales
closing.body: Record today's sales and purchases, then ask the Advisor your first question. It takes about five minutes.

mock.answer: This month {taken} went to personal and adat needs, which leaves {cashLeft} in cash.

metadata.title: TAMAS - Privacy Policy
metadata.description: What TAMAS collects, why, who processes it, and your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: TAMAS is an AI business assistant for MSMEs in Bali, run by {operator}. This policy explains what we collect, why, who processes it for us, and the rights you have under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU No. 27 Tahun 2022).

beta.title: During the beta: AI on Google Gemini's free tier
beta.body: While TAMAS is in beta, its AI features run on the free tier of the Google Gemini API. Under Google's terms for that tier, Google may use what TAMAS sends to improve its products, and people at Google may review it. We recommend using sample data, or leaving out details you would rather keep private. Before TAMAS leaves beta we will move to Gemini's paid tier, where Google does not use this content to improve its products, and update this policy.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.account: Account: your email address and password (stored hashed by our authentication provider), or the name, email and picture Google shares when you sign in with Google; and a username.
collect.profile: Business profile you choose to give: business name, business type, regency or city, and who your main customers are.
collect.records: Your records: transactions (amount, type, category, description, date).
collect.images: Receipt photos and screenshots you upload: sent once to Google Gemini to be read, then discarded. TAMAS does not store the image, and the photo's location data is removed on your device before it is sent. What was read is only saved after you review it and press Save.
collect.conversations: AI Advisor conversations: your questions and the Advisor's answers, so you can return to them. They are kept until you delete the conversation or your account.
collect.suggestion: AI suggestion on the dashboard: the latest one, so it is not made again every time you open the dashboard. It is only made in Personal mode, and is replaced by the next one.
collect.settings: Settings: your language and whether the AI Advisor may use your data.
collect.usage: AI usage records: when you used an AI feature and how many tokens it took, to enforce fair-use limits and measure cost. Not the content of your messages.
collect.analytics: Product analytics: events such as “signed up”, “transaction created” or “advisor answer rated”, linked to a random account ID. They never include amounts, descriptions or profile answers.
collect.noSale: We never ask for bank or e-wallet logins, and we do not sell your data or show ads.

use.title: How we use it
use.run: To run the app: save and show your records.
use.ai: To power AI features: turning a sentence or a receipt photo into transactions, answering your questions, and searching your records.
use.safety: To keep the service safe and within fair-use limits.
use.improve: To understand which features help, so we can improve TAMAS.

processors.title: Who processes your data for us
processors.gemini: Google (Gemini API): the text you type into quick entry and the AI Advisor, the receipt photos and screenshots you upload (TAMAS sends each one once to read it and does not store it), and every transaction you save (type, category, description, amount, date), which is turned into a search index so the Advisor can find it. In Personal mode, the Advisor also receives your profile answers and the transactions it looks up to answer you, and the dashboard suggestion is made from your business name and type and this month's summary figures. You can switch to General mode in the Advisor at any time.
processors.googleSignIn: Google (Sign in with Google): only if you choose to sign in with Google.
processors.abroad: Some of these providers process data outside Indonesia. We use them only to provide TAMAS.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your data while you have an account. When you delete your account in Profile, your profile, records, Advisor conversations, AI suggestion, settings and AI usage records are deleted immediately. You can also delete a single conversation from the Advisor's history at any time. To have your analytics events deleted as well, contact us.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.access: See and take your data: download all your transactions as a CSV file in Profile.
rights.correct: Correct it: edit any transaction or profile answer.
rights.delete: Delete it: delete single records, or your whole account in Profile.
rights.withdraw: Withdraw consent: switch the AI Advisor to General mode.
rights.contactEmail: For anything else, or to file a complaint, email us at <link>{email}</link>.
rights.contactPending: For anything else, or to file a complaint, contact us. A contact email will be listed here before the beta opens.

security.title: Security
security.body: Every record is tied to your account, and the database refuses requests for anyone else's data. Traffic is encrypted with HTTPS, and keys that can bypass these rules never leave our servers.

age.title: Age
age.body: TAMAS is meant for people aged 18 and over.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: When we change this policy we update the date above, and tell you in the app when the change affects what we collect or who processes it.

metadata.title: TAMAS - Terms of Service
metadata.description: The rules for using TAMAS: the beta service, the limits of AI advice, your data, and what each of us is responsible for.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of TAMAS, an AI business assistant for MSMEs in Bali, run by {operator}. By creating an account or using TAMAS, you agree to them. If you don't, please don't use TAMAS.

service.title: About the service
service.what: TAMAS helps owners of micro-businesses record sales and purchases, see profit and cash left, and ask the AI Advisor questions.
service.beta: TAMAS is still in beta. Features may change, be unavailable for a while, or be discontinued, and we do not promise the service will always be free of interruptions or errors.

account.title: Your account
account.accurate: The information you give when you sign up is accurate.
account.secure: You keep your password safe and are responsible for activity on your account. If someone else is using your account, contact us right away.

records.title: Your records and data
records.own: The records and profile answers you enter stay yours. You allow us to process them only to run TAMAS, as described in the <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
records.control: You can download your transactions as a CSV file, and delete your records or your whole account, at any time in Profile.
records.others: Enter only data you are allowed to use. Don't upload photos or personal data of other people that you have no right to share.

ai.title: AI and the limits of its advice
ai.mistakes: AI Advisor's answers, and what the AI reads from a sentence or a receipt photo, are produced by an AI model and can be wrong. Check every draft before you save it, and check important figures before you decide anything.
ai.figures: Profit, cash left and the end-of-month estimate in TAMAS are simple figures for micro-businesses. Materials and equipment count as costs when bought, and the end-of-month estimate is only a rough guess. None of it is an accounting statement.
ai.advice: AI Advisor gives general guidance. It is not accounting, tax, legal or investment advice, and it does not recommend specific investment products. For those, ask a licensed professional.
ai.beta: During the beta, AI runs on Google Gemini's free tier. What that means for your data is explained in the Privacy Policy.

use.title: What you must not do
use.law: Use TAMAS for anything unlawful, or to record made-up transactions in order to deceive others.
use.content: Upload content that is harmful or infringes other people's rights.
use.attack: Try to break into, disrupt, or put excessive load on the service.
use.limits: Get around the usage limits, or call the AI features with automated programs.

limits.title: Fair-use limits
limits.body: AI features have per-minute and per-day limits for each user, to keep the service fair and affordable. When the AI limit runs out, you can still record through the form.

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: The TAMAS name, logo, design and software belong to {operator} or its licensors. As a user you may use them, but you may not copy them, resell them, or claim to own them.

termination.title: Ending your account
termination.you: You can stop at any time by deleting your account in Profile. Your data is deleted as described in the Privacy Policy.
termination.us: We may limit or close an account that breaks these terms or abuses the service, and we may end TAMAS or the beta. When that happens, we tell you in the app first where we can.

liability.title: Limit of liability
liability.body: During the beta, TAMAS is provided as it is. To the extent the law allows, {operator} is not liable for indirect losses, or for business decisions you make based on TAMAS's figures or answers. This does not reduce the rights the law gives you as a consumer.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: When these terms change, we update the date above, and tell you in the app if the change affects your rights or duties. If you keep using TAMAS after that, you are treated as agreeing to the new terms.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Indonesia. If a dispute comes up, let's first try to settle it by talking, through the contact below.

contact.title: Contact
contact.pending: Questions about these terms? Contact {operator}. A contact email will be listed here before the beta opens.
